action: If you are a Caixa Vida e Previdência client, be wary of calls, emails or messages that cite your CPF or policy. Do not share codes or passwords, and use the company's official channel for questions.
exec: One of Brazil's largest disclosed breaches this year; regulator ANPD is assessing whether customer notification and harm prevention were adequate.
impact: Registration data was copied out of the company's environment; affected clients are being notified.
plain: Hackers copied personal details of 7.6 million customers of a Brazilian insurer tied to state bank Caixa. Passwords and balances are not believed to be affected.
summary: The insurer and pension company, part of Caixa Seguridade, told the market on November 12 that intruders detected on November 6 copied registration data from a database covering 7.6 million clients: names, CPF tax IDs, addresses, phones, emails and birth dates. It says no financial data or passwords appear affected. Data regulator ANPD is reviewing the response.
title: Caixa Vida e Previdência breach exposes data of 7.6 million clients in Brazil

validation.note: Three Brazilian outlets report the company's market statement with the same figures.
